description.text: One of the two expansions that opened the Pokémon Card Game Scarlet & Violet series on 20 January 2023, released together with Scarlet ex, with the first cards of many Pokémon of the Paldea region. The legendary Miraidon ex leads it: its Ability puts up to two Lightning Basic Pokémon onto its player's Bench. Magnezone ex, Iron Treads ex, Spidops ex and the Tera Pokémon Arcanine ex join it, with the Supporters Arven and Miriam. Packs held five cards. The cards are numbered to 78, followed by Art Rare Pokémon, Super Rare Pokémon ex and Supporters, Special Art Rare cards, and gold Ultra Rare Miraidon ex, Rare Candy and basic Lightning Energy. In English many of its cards came out in Scarlet & Violet in March 2023.
